claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (excluded as arXiv v1 of P00183). Would-be primary outcome in v1: generator compliance error against the augmented-Lagrangian TO ground truth on 100 unseen loads (mean 6.2 in Case 1, 20.1 in Case 2), a quality comparison.
claim.location: Sec. 5.4, pp. 9-10 and Figs. 4 and 6 (v1). The abstract and conclusion of v1 compare only with ML benchmarks (static and heuristic data selection); v1 has no timing statement
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not coded (excluded as a duplicate). v1 reports no run time for the generator or the TO solver, so no speed-up is stated or derivable in this version. The speed paragraph coded for P00183 (about 10^-2 s vs 10^2-10^3 s) appears only in the later version.
claim.alternatives: v1, Sec. 5.4 p. 12: mean global volume violation 8.76% (generator) vs 4.89% (ground truth) in Case 1 and 5.00% vs 3.44% in Case 2; no local-constraint violation. The main quantitative results (abstract, Sec. 5.4) are ML-vs-ML: mean compliance error 26.5 / 10.4 / 6.2 (Case 1) and 45.9 / 42.7 / 20.1 (Case 2) for benchmark I, benchmark II and the proposed method

notes: Excluded under PROTOCOL §4 (duplicates) and the closed list (FT-DUPLICATE first). Primary record: P00183 (arXiv 1807.10787 v3, already coded, stratum speed). Identity check (2026-09-24): the pool record P01004 is OpenAlex W2884778159; it has no DOI, its only location is export.arxiv.org/pdf/1807.10787, and its title, authors and date (2018-07-27) match arXiv 1807.10787 v1 exactly (arXiv abs page of v1). The current arXiv title is the P00183 title. The study is the same: a CNN generator is trained by theory-driven active learning, where the deviation from the TO optimality conditions selects new training problems, compared with a static dataset (benchmark I) and heuristic selection (benchmark II) on 2D compliance problems on a 40x120 mesh (Sec. 5). P00183 notes the CAD version of record as not open access, so the latest arXiv version (v3, P00183) is the primary version per the FT-DUPLICATE definition. Differences that matter for the verifier: (1) v1 has no timing statement at all; the speed comparison that P00183 codes as primary outcome (Sec. 5.4 of v3) was added later. A v1-only coding would take the compliance gap to the AL ground truth as primary outcome (stratum quality). (2) v1 Case 2 uses |S0| = 2000, |St| = 100, |Dstatic| = 4500 and reports mean errors with large standard deviations (20.1 +/- 35.9 for the proposed method), whereas the P00183 record codes a median gap of 5.2 over 1000 test inputs (v3 Table 1; not re-read here). (3) v1 volume violations for Case 2 (5.00% vs 3.44% ground truth) differ from the v3 values coded in P00183 (1.6% vs 3.0%). (4) Code link in the v1 conclusion: github.com/DesignInformaticsLab/Theory_Driven_TO (same as P00183). Screening flagged this record as a possible duplicate of P00183 (audit/pool/possible_duplicates.csv). COI check: no author named Jun Wang (authors Cang, Yao, Ren).
